ab: Dankanaptera's mouth is filled with various toxin and transfer diseases like rabies when they bite animals. Does 10 DMG and gives you stacks of Rabid Infection, after 10 stacks it activates the status effect called Rabies. Rabies increase the attack damage by 10%. Rabies also activates Vomit which drains your Hunger and Thirst for 10 seconds.
Dankanaptera loves eating berries and nuts.
Add attack damage to dankanaptera' bite attack
Cannot be knocked off while latched.

Gain 200% increased armor for 5 seconds
Must be latched to activate.
Buff decays over time.
Dodge takes 25% less stamina and its cooldown is reduced by 25%.

Dankanaptera are known for producing a strange chemical in their saliva that heals wounds on other animals. increases the Bleed, Poison, Venom, Toxin and Bone break heal rate by 10% and increases Heal Rate by 4 times the normal rate
Dankanaptera use their fur like velcro enabling them to stay attached to larger animals easier. Stamina drains 50% slower while Pouncing
Dankanaptera are often seen in large family groups called Colony. For every Dankanaptera in your group you get a 5% increase in armor. Stack up to 10

Activate to quickly dodge on ground, air or in water. The direction of the dodge is based upon your movement.
Cannot be used while nose diving.
Will be weaker in water.

Dankanaptera are often seen hanging around larger herbivores cleaning wounds and eating parasites of the side of their bodies.
Any Herbivore grouped and within 10 meters of Dankana will get a 50% increase to Poison, Toxic, Bleed and Venom heal rate and inceases heal rate by 25%
Deactivates when in combat.
Dankanaptera are often seen eating insects when fruits are scarce. Can eat Insects and berries
Dankanaptera will often flash their wings to frighten larger predators. Decreases the attack damage of any non group player within 30 meters by 30% for 15 seconds.
When pounced on a group member, redirect most damage they would receive to yourself. You are now immune to Knockback when using Pounce and while latched.
Dankanaptera are known to pounce prey that are big enough for them to rest on. Pounces any large animal, MUST HOLD TO USE
Leap high into the air when detaching from pounced enemies.
